display.title: What Comes Before Modeh Ani? Shivisi Hashem L'negdi Samid
display.summary_short: A riddle: what do we do even before Modeh Ani? Before saying a word, we think that Hashem, who watched over us all night, is right there before us.
display.summary_long: A morning-routine riddle from the Tzivos Hashem radio show. Uncle Yossi asks what we do to start the day correctly, even before Modeh Ani and negel vasser. At bedtime we say the Shema and give Hashem our tired neshamah to hold, and every morning He returns it fresh and full of new strength, which is why we thank Him with Modeh Ani. But even before that, as the first page of the Shulchan Aruch teaches, we must think before Whom we are lying: Hashem stayed at our bedside all night, guarding us from harm. So first comes thought, as Dovid HaMelech said, 'I place Hashem before me always', then speech, Modeh Ani, and then action, washing negel vasser. The mystery is solved: the very first thing is to remember that Hashem is right there before you.
display.lesson: The very first thing when you wake up is to remember that Hashem is right there with you.
